assertions: Every checked page returned HTTP 200 at its original URL.
Every downloaded immutable repository file matched the local tested bytes.
Public GitHub Actions API reported success for the exact release commit.
The browser displayed Connect wallet, visitor access, the requested review ID, stored UTC time and matching assessment.
limitations: A point-in-time availability check, not a future uptime guarantee.
Anonymous HTTP checks are separate from the wallet-disconnected in-app browser check; no claim is made about inspecting browser cookies.
This record does not attempt to include its own immutable publication URL; that URL is checked after the documentation commit exists.
